text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Crisp white zip blouson with pointed collar, subtle seam panels and ribbed waist, medium-blue washed wide jeans, dark glossy gathered-toe leather shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: Dark teal-black cotton military-style short-brim cap with tonal embroidery and small silver star studs; Soft black leather hobo shoulder bag with long broad strap and subtle tonal gothic cross patches; Plain black leather belt with square silver buckle; Silver chain bracelet with small dangling metal charms. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 4 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Dark teal-black cotton military-style short-brim cap with tonal embroidery and small silver star studs; 2. Soft black leather hobo shoulder bag with long broad strap and subtle tonal gothic cross patches; 3. Plain black leather belt with square silver buckle; 4. Silver chain bracelet with small dangling metal charms. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
